paragraphs: R. Menaḥem ben Gufeta, whom Baal Peor's prince visited, Sanhedrin. Jerusalem Talmud, Ḥelek, halakhah 2: an incident concerning Menaḥem of Gufeta Aryeh, who was rolling a barrel. Peor's prince came at night. He took a spit and stood against him, and the prince fled. He came the second night and said, 'Menaḥem, why do you curse me?' Menaḥem feared him and said, 'I shall no longer curse you.' Yalkut, Balak§24: Pinḥas ben Gavta deAryeh.
